nodes.label: Explicit Region Outline Refresh
nodes.rationale: Unity asset extraction is slower and more fragile than template and catalog rebuilds, so checked-in geometry is reused unless a refresh is explicitly requested.

nodes.label: Initial-Owner Claim Authority
nodes.rationale: Scenario-filtered Claim rows with initialOwner=true are authoritative for starting ownership; sorting and display metadata do not represent scenario-specific ownership.

nodes.label: Manifest-Scoped Publication
nodes.rationale: Git work is opt-in and stages only manifest-declared generated paths so unrelated local changes remain untouched.

nodes.label: Generated Pages Output Boundary
nodes.rationale: The docs directory is deployment output, so source changes belong in src, tools, or manual inputs and must be rebuilt.

nodes.label: State, Data, Render, and UI Separation
nodes.rationale: Focused modules remain testable and predictable when state does not render, render does not own app state, data does not depend on visual state, and callbacks carry transitions.
nodes.norm_label: state, data, render, and ui separation

nodes.label: Region Outline Refresh Policy
nodes.rationale: Region outline extraction is intentionally separate and runs only when Unity geometry is being validated or updated.

nodes.label: Plan Document Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Temporary issue plans may be discarded after completion, while still-useful decisions and findings are promoted into durable documentation.

nodes.label: Development Docs Generated-Output Boundary
nodes.rationale: Planning documentation must not be placed in the generated docs deployment tree.

nodes.label: Standard-Library Build and Verification
nodes.rationale: Ordinary build and verification require no third-party Python packages.

nodes.label: Research Grants Claims, Not Immediate Actions
nodes.rationale: Research projects are presented as granting claim prerequisites for later merger, conquest, or unification possibilities rather than performing those actions immediately.
nodes.norm_label: research grants claims, not immediate actions

nodes.label: Verify generated data and unit tests
nodes.norm_label: verify generated data and unit tests
